headers.X-Nexa-Installation-Id: optional 8-64 chars [A-Za-z0-9._-], random, app-scoped: a correlation hint only, never grants access

auth.identity: Ownership is `(tenant, application, subject)`; another user's id is a plain 404.
auth.tokens: The customer's backend mints short-lived `nxs_` tokens with its own `nxk_` key (never in the app). The app never holds an `nxk_` key, a provider key or a GPU address.

availability.rule: Use `available` and `unavailable_reason` from GET /tools; never infer support from model names. Only `available` tools are offered to the model; a listed-but-unavailable tool cannot run.

base.note: The technical namespace stays `nexa`; the customer brand is LABEEB. The production host is the current address; keep it configurable.

compatibility.detect: Every /v1/sdk response carries `X-Nexa-Contract-Version: labeeb.sdk/1.0.0`; `GET /v1/sdk/contract` returns this document (ETag). Send your own version in `X-Nexa-Sdk-Version`.
compatibility.policy: Within `labeeb.sdk/1` changes are additive only. Clients MUST ignore unknown JSON fields, unknown event types, unknown tool names, unknown component types/categories/presentations and unknown enum values of open sets. A breaking change creates `labeeb.sdk/2` served side by side for at least 6 months.

endpoints.summary: This document (unauthenticated, ETag, also `X-Nexa-Contract-Version` on every SDK response).
Create a conversation (idempotent per `client_ref`: 200 with the original).
List own conversations, newest activity first.
One conversation plus `sessions:{active,latest}` for resume.
Rename (`title_source` becomes `user`).
Delete a conversation and everything it owns.
Clear own history (optionally `?kind=chat|voice`).
Chronological page; `next_before` pages to OLDER messages.
Report spoken turns of a call into the shared conversation (idempotent per `client_turn_id`). Answers `server_recorded:true` for tool-enabled calls (the gateway already stored them).

Upload an attachment: raw body, `Content-Type` image/png|jpeg|webp, application/pdf, text/plain|markdown|csv, application/json; optional `X-Nexa-Filename`. 10 MB, 50 per conversation, magic bytes verified.
Asset metadata (owner only).
Asset bytes (`Cache-Control: private, no-store`, `nosniff`).
Delete an asset (messages keep a `deleted_asset` part).
Durable preferences of this user in this app.
Replace preferences (flat keys `[a-z][a-z0-9_.]{0,39}`, <=30 keys, strings <=200 chars).
Delete preferences.
Delete everything this subject owns in this app (conversations, assets, tool state, preferences).
Create a chat session; with `conversation_id` it joins that conversation; `client_tools` declares the device tools this client can run.
End the session (cancels open tool calls).
Send input. Requires `Idempotency-Key`. `text` and/or `ui_event`; `attachments` up to 4 asset ids.
Cancel the assistant reply in progress (409 `already_finished` if it completed first).
Long-poll events: `?after=<sequence>&wait_ms=`; returns `{events, cursor}`.
Server-Sent Events, same events, `?after=`; reconnect with the last `sequence` to replay exactly the missed events.

RESERVED. Accepted and discarded; the gateway never requests permissions through it. Use tool-call approval instead.
Identity and appearance the company set for this application: assistant name, accent colour, https logo, welcome message. Data for the host app to render in its own design.
Tool catalogue for this app with `available` and `unavailable_reason` per tool.
Read one tool call (includes `result.ui` for presented documents).
The user's decision for an `awaiting_approval` call.
The device's answer, accepted once, only while open, validated against the tool's `result` schema. Send `{result}` or `{error:{code,message?,retryable?}}`.
Cancel an open call (also cancels the GPU job of a long-running one).

endpoints.notes: Full voice contract: docs/voice/flutter-integration-contract.md and docs/handoff/voice-contract-v1.md (events are signed and sealed).
endpoints.summary: Create a LiveKit voice session. `tools:true` (+ `client_tools`, scope `tools:use`, a `conversation_id`) enables tools; the response says what you got.
Read the session (`status`, `agent_state`, `end_reason`).
Reconnect: a fresh join token for the SAME identity while the session is live (410 `voice_session_ended` once over).
End the call (billing stops).

errors.rule: Switch on `code`, never on `message`. Unknown codes: treat by HTTP status.

events.delivery: Long-poll `GET /events?after=&wait_ms=` or SSE `GET /events/stream?after=`. Reconnect with the last `sequence`: missed events replay exactly. A message ends with exactly one of `assistant_message_completed|message_failed|message_cancelled`.

tool_call_progress.notes: Long jobs only. `state` is an open set.

tool_call_requested.notes: Client tools: show consent when `status` is `awaiting_approval`, run the tool when `awaiting_client`. Server tools arrive `running`.

voice.large_ui: Large documents arrive as `{id, category, truncated:true}`: read the full one with `GET /sessions/{tools.session_id}/tool-calls/{id}`.
voice.sealed: Voice events are signed and sealed on a LiveKit data topic; see docs/voice/event-contract.md and docs/handoff/fixtures/events. Tool events (`tool_call_*`, `asset_created`, `ui_presented`) have the same fields as the SSE events; the phone answers device tools over HTTPS with `tools.session_id`.

jobs.ids: The `tool_call_id` is the stable job id.
jobs.model: Long jobs (image.generate, image.edit) answer `status: running` immediately; the assistant tells the user it started. Progress: `tool_call_progress`. Result: `asset_created` + an assistant message. Failure: `tool_call_failed` + an assistant message. Ask: tool `jobs.status`. Stop: tool `jobs.cancel` or POST .../cancel. After a gateway restart a running job is resumed, not lost.
jobs.never: Never show a job as finished before `tool_call_completed`/`asset_created`.

rules: Show attribution: Places `attribution`, news `publisher` + `seen_at` (first seen, NEVER "published"), web `source` + `url`, sports `source`, video `channel` + link.
`coverage: encyclopedia_only` results are reference articles, not live web results.
Sports `state` is `live` only when the provider says so.
Place content older than 30 days is reduced to `{rank,id}`.

status_vocabulary.BACKEND_READY: Implemented and tested in the gateway (mock GPU/providers); not yet proven against the real dependency on production.
status_vocabulary.CONTRACT_DEFINED: The request/response/event shapes are frozen here; the backend may not implement them yet.
status_vocabulary.E2E_VERIFIED: Exercised on production against the real dependency (model, provider) from the SDK-facing API. A device is played by a script until the Flutter client exists.
status_vocabulary.GPU_BLOCKED: Backend ready; real results are blocked by a GPU Manager issue. The API still answers truthfully (an error or an unavailable state), never a fake result.
status_vocabulary.PROVIDER_BLOCKED: Backend ready; real results are blocked by a missing or rate-limited external provider. The API reports `requires_configuration` / `provider_*` and never fabricates results.

summary: Everything the Flutter SDK needs: chat, history, attachments, tools, device tools, dynamic UI, themes, jobs, voice. Shapes are real; features carry an honest status.

flow: user touches or says the option -> ui_event on POST /messages
app.theme.apply (client tool) with arguments.colors resolved by the server
host previews -> user confirms or cancels -> approval + result {status: applied|cancelled, palette_id?, mode?}
theme.host_callback: Only register theme tools in `client_tools` when the host app provides a theme callback. Nothing is applied without the callback and the user's confirmation. Persist the choice with PUT /me/preferences.

error_codes.cancelled: the user or hang-up cancelled it
error_codes.domain_not_allowed: app allow-list or keyless mode cannot honour this scope
error_codes.gpu_busy: the GPU could not start the job (reserved for live voice); retryable
error_codes.gpu_capacity: not enough free GPU memory right now (kept free for live voice); retryable
error_codes.gpu_not_permitted: the GPU service has not enabled this model or operation for the app; operator action needed, not retryable
error_codes.jira_bad_request: Jira rejected the query (e.g. invalid JQL); not retryable
error_codes.jira_forbidden: the connected Jira user may not see this (Jira's own permissions)
error_codes.jira_no_sprints: the board does not use sprints (e.g. Kanban)
error_codes.jira_not_connected: the organization has not connected Jira (company admin action)
error_codes.jira_not_found: not found, or not visible to the connected user or this application
error_codes.jira_reconnect_required: the Jira authorization expired or was revoked; company admin reconnects
error_codes.jira_site_not_selected: the connection has several Jira sites and none is selected
error_codes.job_not_found: no such job in this conversation
error_codes.no_model_selected: the app has no model for this task
error_codes.not_readable: file cannot be read as text
error_codes.requires_configuration: provider not configured for this deployment

rules: Client tools need the device declaration in `client_tools` at session creation.
Answer once; a closed call answers 409 `tool_call_closed`.
Deadlines are enforced server-side; an unanswered call becomes `expired`.
Never execute anything the gateway did not send: URLs come only from validated `arguments`.

statuses.awaiting_approval: client tool: show consent UI, then POST approval
statuses.awaiting_client: client tool approved: run it and POST the result
statuses.running: server tool or long job in progress

rules: Render with the host ThemeData; never apply styles from the document.
Every selectable thing has a stable id and a 1-based `ordinal`: a touch and "the second one" resolve to the same id.
Links are https only; `open_url` and `link` open the external browser after consent.
Unknown component types are skipped, not fatal.
